# Ben Island

> A creative web tool platform featuring interactive GIF generation and image animation utilities built for the browser.

Ben Island is a Neocities-hosted site that specializes in web-based tools for creating and manipulating animated images. The site focuses on accessible, browser-based tools that require no installation or complex setup.

## Key Topics

- GIF animation
- petpet tool
- interactive editor
- browser-based
- image animation
- GIF export
- web tool
- mobile-friendly
- image effects
- petpet maker
- JSON
- Neocities

## Petpet Tools

- [petpet](https://benisland.neocities.org/petpet): Interactive petpet GIF generator with browser-based editing and export
- [petpet v1](https://benisland.neocities.org/petpet/v1): Petpet v1 GIF animation tool by Ben Island for creating animated images
